```{r}
onerow_per_sample_exon4 <- combined_filteredtissues_ordered_exon4 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(sample) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    inc_3_4 = read_counts[junction_type == "3_4"],
    inc_4_5 = read_counts[junction_type == "4_5"],
    total_inclusion = sum(
      read_counts[junction_type == "3_4"] +
      read_counts[junction_type == "4_5"],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    skipping = read_counts[junction_type == "3_5"],
    SEX = gtex.sex[!is.na(gtex.sex)][1],
    AGE = gtex.age[!is.na(gtex.age)][1],
    SUBJID = gtex.subjid[!is.na(gtex.subjid)][1],
    SMTSD = gtex.smtsd[!is.na(gtex.smtsd)][1],
    bc_auc.all_reads_annotated_bases =
      recount_qc.bc_auc.all_reads_annotated_bases[!is.na(recount_qc.bc_auc.all_reads_annotated_bases)][1],
    `star.uniquely_mapped_reads_%_both` = `recount_qc.star.uniquely_mapped_reads_._both`[!is.na(`recount_qc.star.uniquely_mapped_reads_._both`)][1],
    junction_avg_coverage = recount_qc.junction_avg_coverage[!is.na(recount_qc.junction_avg_coverage)][1],
    RIN_number = gtex.smrin[!is.na(gtex.smrin)][1],
    Nucleic_acid_isolation_batch = gtex.smnabtch[!is.na(gtex.smnabtch)][1],
    Genotype_or_expression_batch = gtex.smgebtch[!is.na(gtex.smgebtch)][1],
    Classification_death = gtex.dthhrdy[!is.na(gtex.dthhrdy)][1],
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# unfiltered model without all the covariats (simplest model)

simplest_model_exon4 <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(skipping, total_inclusion) ~ 
    SMTSD + 
    SEX + 
    AGE +
    (1 | SUBJID),
  
  family = betabinomial(),
  data = merged_onerow_per_sample_exon4
)

emm_tmb_simplest_model_exon4 <- emmeans(simplest_model_exon4, ~ SMTSD)
pairs_tmb_simplest_model_exon4 <- pairs(emm_tmb_simplest_model_exon4, adjust = "BH")
simplest_model_exon4
pairs_tmb_simplest_model_exon4
```

```{r}
exon4_dist_exact_base_recount3 <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon4 %>%
  mutate(
    skipping_capped = ifelse(skipping >= 10, "10+", as.character(skipping))
  ) %>%
  group_by(SMTSD, skipping_capped) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(SMTSD) %>%
  mutate(
    total_tissue = sum(n),
    pct = 100 * n / total_tissue
  )

ggplot(
  exon4_dist_exact_base_recount3,
  aes(
    x = factor(skipping_capped,
               levels = c(as.character(0:9), "10+")),
    y = pct
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 1.0) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ SMTSD) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Exon 9 skipping read count",
    y = "Percentage of samples within tissue"
  ) +
  ylim(0, max(exon4_dist_exact_base_recount3$pct) * 1.1)
```

```{r}
exon4_dist_exact_base_recount3 <- merged_onerow_per_sample_exon4 %>%
  mutate(
    psi_sum = skipping / (skipping + total_inclusion),
    psi_bin = cut(
      psi_sum,
      breaks = c(
        0,
        0.001,
        0.005,
        0.01,
        0.02,
        0.05,
        0.1,
        0.2,
        1
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(SMTSD, psi_bin) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(SMTSD) %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n))

ggplot(exon4_dist_exact_base_recount3, aes(x = psi_bin, y = pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", width = 1) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", pct)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 1.8
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ SMTSD) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "PSI bin",
    y = "Percentage of samples within tissue"
  ) +
  ylim(0, max(exon4_dist_exact_base_recount3$pct) * 1.1)
```

```{r}
pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon4_df <- as.data.frame(pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon4)

# Filter Breast comparisons
pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon4_df <- pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon4_df %>%
  filter(grepl("Breast - Mammary Tissue", contrast))

# Compute effects + significance + modified labels
pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon4_df <- pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon4_df %>%
  mutate(
    odds_ratio = exp(estimate),
    percent_difference = (odds_ratio - 1) * 100,
    lower_ci = (exp(estimate - 1.96 * SE) - 1) * 100,
    upper_ci = (exp(estimate + 1.96 * SE) - 1) * 100,

    sig = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),

    # clean tissue label + add stars
    tissue = gsub(".*Breast - Mammary Tissue - ", "", contrast),
    tissue = paste0(tissue, sig)
  )

# Plot with stars in labels
ggplot(pairs_tmb_mainmodel_exon4_df,
       aes(x = percent_difference, y = reorder(tissue, percent_difference))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(xmin = lower_ci, xmax = upper_ci),
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Percent difference in exon skipping odds vs Breast",
    y = "Tissue"
  )
```
